props.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
props.subheading: Everything you need to know about booking, treatment plans, and financing.

items.question: Do you accept new patients?
items.answer: Yes, we are actively welcoming new private and family patients. You can book an initial consultation online or call our Manchester reception.

items.question: What if I experience intense dental anxiety?
items.answer: Please let us know when booking. We offer longer introductory appointments, gentle step-by-step explanations, and anxiety sedation options.

items.question: Do you offer payment plans or finance?
items.answer: Yes. We partner with reputable medical credit providers to offer 0% interest monthly payment options over 6, 10, or 12 months for treatments exceeding £500.

items.question: How quickly can I be seen for a dental emergency?
items.answer: We reserve dedicated emergency slots every weekday morning and afternoon. Call us before 10:00am for priority same-day scheduling.
